proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger for ClassFeatureComponentMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack fires on a qualifying weapon hit, not on activation or as a passive grant. The on_hit_trigger family exists for MasteryMechanics and MagicItemComponentMechanics but is absent from ClassFeatureComponentMechanics. No honest encoding is possible without adding this family to class features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll

proposed_widenings.name: damage effect in MasteryEffect / on-hit rider effect
proposed_widenings.justification: MasteryEffect only covers modify_roll_advantage, save_gate, and grant_weapon_attack. Sneak Attack's effect is extra damage dice of weapon type, which is not expressible through any existing MasteryEffect variant. A 'damage' variant referencing weapon damage type is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can deal an extra 1d6 damage... The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_damage_type DamageTypeRef variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage type is not a fixed DamageType nor a cast-time choice — it inherits the type of the weapon used. No existing DamageTypeRef variant expresses 'same as wielded weapon'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type

proposed_widenings.name: conditional on-hit trigger predicate (advantage OR ally-adjacent)
proposed_widenings.justification: MasteryTrigger is a bare weapon_hit or weapon_hit_melee_only with no conditional predicates. Sneak Attack has a two-branch trigger condition: (Advantage + Finesse/Ranged) OR (ally within 5ft + ally not Incapacitated + no Disadvantage). Neither branch is expressible on the current trigger surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon... You don't need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage

notes: The unit is structurally blocked at the family level: ClassFeatureComponentMechanics = PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics, and neither family can express an on-hit damage rider. The on_hit_trigger family exists for MasteryMechanics and MagicItemComponentMechanics but not for class features. Even if that gap were bridged, three additional widenings are required: (1) a damage variant in the on-hit rider effect union, (2) a 'weapon type' DamageTypeRef variant, and (3) a conditional trigger predicate for the advantage/ally-adjacent OR logic. The per-level scaling (1d6 to 10d6 by Rogue level threshold) would fit cleanly via DiceAmount.threshold_tiers with axis='class' once the other gaps are resolved.
